about.title: Hello World!
about.p1: I'm a {dev} since a very young age. My curiosity about tinkering with electronics quickly turned into a fascination with how things work and {break}.
about.p2: That curiosity led me to programming and {sec}. I started studying {java} in my teens, dove deeper into {backend}, and later expanded to {js} for {front}. Along the way, I kept coming back to security: how systems are protected, how data are kept safe, how failures happen and so many other questions.
about.p3: I've been applying security practices to development, such as authentication and authorization ({jwt}), data encryption and {lgpd} compliance, while studying {cyber} across different areas, including {red}, {blue}, {corp} and {appsec}.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: Real projects, robust solutions, and clean code.

sbom_guard.title: SBOM Guard
sbom_guard.desc: Security CLI tool for the software supply chain, built in Java 21, that maps dependencies, generates SBOM (CycloneDX), attests integrity, and verifies builds with digital signatures. It implements 100% native JDK cryptography (Ed25519 + SHA-256) with no external dependencies, plus an append-only ledger and hash chaining for immutable audits. Deterministic exit codes ready to be used as a gate in CI/CD pipelines, with 145 automated tests covering all modules.

music_lib.title: Music Library
music_lib.desc: Complete platform for managing compositions, involving chords, audios, verses, and more. The backend was developed with rigorous quality standards, implementing robust authentication and authorization via Spring Security, JWT, User management, DTOs, JPA test database generation, etc. The layered architecture and dependency management via Maven ensure a highly scalable, secure, and easy-to-maintain system, prepared for high concurrency.

bio_synth.title: Bio Synth
bio_synth.desc: Chemical evolution simulator focused on high performance and parallel computing. Developed in pure Java, the engine processes thousands of simultaneous cellular interactions using Multithreading and optimized neighborhood logic. The architecture implements Design Patterns such as Strategy and SOLID (OCP) for decoupled evolution rules, while Graphics2D rendering ensures visual fluidity and high-speed execution without external dependencies.
